annotations.title: utilpeek: render Markdown to sanitized HTML

description: utilpeek: Convert Markdown to sanitized HTML. For the reverse use html_to_text. Returns the HTML of a Markdown document (markdown-it-py; `gfm` adds tables, strikethrough, autolinks and task lists), cleaned by an allow-list sanitizer (nh3): no scripts, event handlers, iframes, forms or javascript:/data: links; every link gets rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer". HTML over 4 MB is a 422 output_too_large. Parsed in an isolated, resource-limited child process without network; input over its limits is a 422 (not charged). Typically under 0.5 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/markdown-to-html-api.html
